item.title: Knoch dominates Deer Lakes for section win
item.description: Knoch didn’t just knock on Deer Lakes’ door. The Knights barged in and outdueled the Lancers on their senior night with a 50-29 victory and kept themselves in first place in Section 1-4A.

item.title: Latrobe boys use size to claw past Franklin Regional in must-win game
item.description: Latrobe had a contest at halftime called “Can the Cats” where children tried to throw small, rubber cats into a trash can.

item.title: Moon shows postseason form in decisive win over section rival Mars
item.description: After a first quarter that was a bit back and forth Friday night at Moon, the host Tigers raced away with a fourth-straight win, beating Mars, 76-38, in Section 4-5A play.

item.title: Charleroi boys beat Mt. Pleasant in meaningful matchup with history
item.description: Joe Dunn was back in the house Friday night at Mt. Pleasant. So were some of his former players.

item.title: Seahawks sale rumors swirl ahead of Super Bowl; Paul Allen’s estate denies report
item.description: SEATTLE — The Seattle Seahawks will go up for sale after the team’s appearance in the Super Bowl on Feb. 8, ESPN reported Friday night.

item.title: Minor league report: Nailers dropped by Railers
item.description: Goaltender Maxim Pavlenko made 18 saves on 24 shots for the Wheeling Nailers in a 6-3 loss to the Worcester Railers at the DCU Center in Worcester, Mass., on Friday.

item.title: Fox Chapel wrestlers gearing up for postseason tournaments
item.description: The Fox Chapel wrestling team is grateful to have a few weeks between the end of its dual season and the start of the individual wrestling tournaments. The Foxes’ lineup accrued a large number of bumps and bruises throughout the season.

item.title: High school roundup for Jan. 30, 2026: Pine-Richland stuns New Castle, Fox Chapel beats North Hills in chaotic 6A playoff race
item.description: Joe McGivney scored a career-high 22 points to lead Fox Chapel to a 60-48 victory over North Hills for a key win in a crowded Section 1-6A boys basketball playoff race.

item.title: WPIAL clinched: Boys basketball playoff qualifiers through Friday, Jan. 30, 2026
item.description: After a frosty start, the stretch run has just over a week left as the WPIAL boys basketball playoff field is building with 53 teams that have now clinched a district postseason berth.
